references.text: Describes the same event where Jesus leaves the disciples alone in the boat while the crowd remains on land, creating the context for verse 22.
Tells of the disciples' journey across the sea in the boat without Jesus, which is the direct event the crowd observes and comments on in verse 22.
Parallel account in Mark describing the disciples who went into the boat alone while Jesus was on land, confirming the situation in John 6:22.
The crowd that has seen Jesus disappear in the boat now seeks him on the other side of the sea, a direct consequence of the observation in verse 22.
